panels.title: Battery flow
panels.description: Positive = charging, negative = discharging.

panels.title: Grid supply (last 24h)
panels.description: Hours with grid power present in the last 24 hours.

panels.title: Grid availability
panels.description: 1 = grid on, 0 = grid off. Each drop is a power cut.

panels.title: Daily energy (last 30 days)
panels.description: Estimated from average power over each day. The first day after deployment is partial.

panels.title: Battery runtime at current draw
panels.description: Hours until the battery reaches the reserve, at the average battery discharge of the last 10 minutes (solar included). Shows 'Charging' when the battery isn't discharging.

panels.title: Overnight runtime (no solar)
panels.description: Hours the battery would last with no solar and no grid, at the last hour's average house load plus the inverter's own consumption.

panels.title: Battery energy left (above reserve)
panels.description: Usable energy left before the inverter's cut-off, based on the configured capacity and reserve.

panels.title: Solar this month
panels.description: Solar energy produced since the start of this month.

panels.title: Solar value this month
panels.description: What this month's solar energy would have cost from the grid (EKEDC Band A, incl. VAT).

panels.title: Solar all time
panels.description: Solar energy produced since tracking began.

panels.title: Solar value all time
panels.description: Value of all solar energy since tracking began, at the current tariff (EKEDC Band A, incl. VAT).

panels.title: Grid used this month
panels.description: Energy imported from the grid since the start of this month.

panels.title: Grid cost this month
panels.description: Estimated cost of this month's grid energy (EKEDC Band A, incl. VAT).

panels.title: Inverter load
panels.description: House load as a share of the inverter's 3 kW rating.

panels.title: Battery current
panels.description: Negative = discharging.

panels.title: Load all time
panels.description: Since tracking began.

panels.title: Grid all time
panels.description: Since tracking began.

panels.title: Ah available
panels.description: Amp-hours left in the battery (SOC x 200 Ah).

panels.title: Equivalent full cycles
panels.description: Total energy discharged since tracking began, divided by the battery's 5.12 kWh. Rated for 6,000+ cycles at 80% depth.

panels.title: Peak power per hour: solar vs load
Savings this month vs grid
panels.description: This month's solar energy at the grid tariff (EKEDC Band A incl. VAT).

panels.title: Savings vs generator this month
panels.description: This month's solar energy at your generator running cost.

panels.title: Savings vs generator (all time)
panels.description: Since tracking began.

panels.title: Recovered so far (vs grid)
panels.description: Share of the ₦3m system cost covered by solar savings since tracking began, at the grid tariff.

panels.title: Recovered so far (vs generator)
panels.description: Same, valuing solar at your generator running cost.

panels.title: Yearly value of your solar, by what it replaces
panels.description: Your solar's projected yearly output (from the average so far) valued at a blended grid/generator rate. Early estimates settle after a few weeks.

panels.title: Payback period, by what it replaces
panels.description: Years for solar savings to cover the ₦3m system cost, for each supply mix.

panels.title: PV forecast today
panels.description: Forecast.Solar estimate for 2.2 kWp (south, 10° tilt assumed).

panels.title: PV remaining today
panels.description: Today's forecast minus what the panels have produced so far.

panels.title: Outdoor temperature
panels.description: Open-Meteo, Surulere.

panels.title: Cloud cover
panels.description: High cloud cover means lower solar output.

panels.title: Time to full charge
panels.description: Hours until the battery reaches 100%, at the average charging power of the last 10 minutes. LiFePO4 batteries charge more slowly over the last few percent, so the final stretch may take a little longer than shown.
